Champions League finals

Barcelona's three and Real Madrid's four finals in the open data, measured exactly like the league matches and set against the team's own matches that season: was the final played differently?

A final is one match, so it is compared with single matches: the band is the middle 90% of the team's matches, the dots are those matches. Barcelona: its La Liga matches of the same season. Real Madrid: its 2015/16 league season for the 2016 final; otherwise the Clásicos of the same period, the only Real Madrid league matches in the data, so those finals are compared with Real Madrid's other biggest games. Extra time is left out of the metrics, as everywhere on this site.
